note: Reflex policy pack: aws. Copy it with `reflex policy init --pack aws`, then commit .reflex/policy.json. It only adds checks. deny rules block in every mode; ask rules go to a human, and in the autonomous profile never to System 2. Patterns are case-insensitive and read the command plus its context (aws_profile=, kube_context=, tf_workspace=, git_branch=, cwd=). The prod markers treat AWS profiles with names that contain prod as a separate part (prod, prod-eu, acme-prod, production, prod01, cluster/prod-eu; not nonprod) as production, so a command there that is not read-only asks. Rename them to match your profiles.

rules.rule: deletes an RDS database without a final snapshot
rules.note: deny: the data is gone for good. Delete with a final snapshot, or by hand.

rules.rule: deletes an RDS or Aurora database
rules.note: ask: a human confirms any database or snapshot delete, in every environment.

rules.rule: removes an S3 bucket together with its objects
rules.note: deny: rb --force empties the bucket first. Empty and remove it by hand if you mean it.

rules.rule: turns off AWS audit logging or threat detection
rules.note: deny: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Config and Security Hub are evidence for audits; an agent never switches them off.

rules.rule: schedules deletion of, or disables, a KMS key
rules.note: deny: data encrypted with the key becomes unreadable.

rules.rule: changes IAM (an aws iam command that is not read-only)
rules.note: ask: any aws iam command that is not read-only (get-, list- pass before the rules). IAM changes decide what every other credential can do.

rules.rule: changes AWS Organizations (a command that is not read-only)
rules.note: ask: any aws organizations command that is not read-only. SCPs and account moves apply to the whole organization.

rules.rule: terminates EC2 instances or deletes volumes or snapshots
rules.note: ask: instance store and unsnapshotted volumes do not come back.

rules.rule: changes Route 53 records or hosted zones
rules.note: ask: a DNS change can take a service offline for every user.

rules.rule: deletes a DynamoDB table or backup
rules.note: ask: the table and its items go with it.

always_human.note: never approved by System 2 in the autonomous profile, always a human
